purpose: Deterministic re-run of Foundation-only training as part of V1.0 hardening pass, to test whether full seeding (random/numpy/torch/cuda + seeded DataLoader + cudnn.deterministic + torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True)) resolves the run-to-run variance documented in foundation_only_stability_note.json.
environment: Kaggle (Tesla T4), fresh DINOv2 embedding extraction (not reused from Drive cache)
finding: Even with full determinism enabled, this run produced test AUROC=0.9168, DIFFERENT from the original historical value (0.9054) and from two earlier non-deterministic reruns (0.9116, 0.8785). This indicates the instability is not solely explained by missing seeding -- the small validation set (961 samples) appears to make best-epoch selection genuinely sensitive to minor environmental differences (e.g. Colab vs Kaggle library versions, hardware). This result is reported as-is, without cherry-picking.
relationship_to_historical_result: This does NOT replace the historical reported value (0.9054). Both are preserved. See results/foundation_only_metrics.json for the original, and results/foundation_only_stability_note.json for the full instability history.
